theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl (m + 1) → Eucl P) (Ω : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (B : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (χ : Eucl (m + 1) → Eucl (m + 1)) (S : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (g : Eucl P → ℝ≥0∞), ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → (∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzOnWith K Φ Ω) → (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → IsOpen B → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 χ B → χ '' B ⊆ Ω → (∃ Λ : ℝ≥0, LipschitzOnWith Λ χ B) → (∀ (t : ℝ) (v v' : Eucl m), (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons t (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ v)) ∈ B → (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons t (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ v')) ∈ B → ‖v - v'‖ ≤ ‖χ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons t (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ v))) - χ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons t (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ v')))‖) → MeasurableSet S → Measurable g → ∀ t : ℝ, ∫⁻ x in (fun v : Eucl m => Φ (χ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons t (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ v))))) '' {v : Eucl m | (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons t (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ v)) ∈ B ∩ χ ⁻¹' S}, g x ∂(μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) = ∫⁻ v : Eucl m, (B ∩ χ ⁻¹' S).indicator (fun y => g (Φ (χ y)) * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin m => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ (χ y) (fderiv ℝ χ y (EuclideanSpace.single i.succ 1))) (fderiv ℝ Φ (χ y) (fderiv ℝ χ y (EuclideanSpace.single j.succ 1)))).det)) ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons t (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ v))) ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl m))
